title: 第四章     遭逢变故
content_zh:
轰隆隆！轰隆隆！一道道闪电划破夜空，风呼呼地刮着，雨哗哗地下着，街道上连一个人影也没有，大雨宛如听到天神信号，撕开天幕，把天河之水倾注到人间。

    风雨之下的诸葛家族显得分外压抑，诸葛擎天正坐在大厅上，手里抓着一张八百里加急的战报。

    诸葛擎天——星辰帝国大元帅，在星辰帝国即将灭国之际，诸葛擎天横空出世，凭借着出色的军事才能力挽狂澜，挽救了即将亡国的星辰帝国。星辰帝国将士在其带领下乘胜追击，击败了其他帝国联盟并将星辰帝国版图扩张至最大。

    此时的诸葛擎天老泪众横，因为战报上写着：诸葛辰轩元帅所率领的军队在卡其顿帝国枫林之地受不明身份的人攻击，致使军队全军覆没，诸葛辰轩在亲兵护卫下奋力突围，目前生死不明。诸葛问心，诸葛问道皆已战死……

    “父亲，怎么了？是不是辰轩出事了，你说句啊！”说话的是诸葛辰轩的结发妻子李欣儿。

    面对着儿媳妇的询问，这位在无数大大小小的战争面前都面不改色的老人如今却也变得束手无措。

    “儿媳妇如今你有身孕在身切不可太激动我说你且好好听着，辰轩，问心，问道所率领的20万大军在枫林遭到突袭，问心，问道已经战死，辰轩生死不明。”老人无力道。

    “什么问心、问道战死，辰轩生死不明？”李欣儿喃喃着。“生死不明，生死不明，怎么会这样？父亲你告诉我这不是真的，你告诉我啊！”

    “这是真的。”

    “这不可能，我不相信，我不相信！”李欣儿慌忙的退步着。“呃！呃！父亲我要生了，父亲如果我不行了，你无论如何也要保住我和辰轩的孩子。”李欣儿凄然道。

    “来人啊，快去叫产婆，少夫人要生了”老人对着仆人急忙传唤。

    “如今我诸葛一族遭受如此变故，这孩子千万不要出事啊，这是我诸葛一族唯一的血脉，无论如何也要保住这一根独苗！”站在产房前的老人踱步着。

    吱吖！产婆从房里走了出来。“怎样，少夫人生产是否顺利？”老人急切的问。

    “老太爷，母子目前情况不太好，少夫人难产，胎儿横位！胎儿和少夫人只能保一个”。

    “怎么会这样，为什么？产婆再试试能不能保得住母子平安。”

    “对不起，我最多只能保一人平安”产婆悲切地说着。

    “父亲，保住我的孩子，这是我的决定，希望您成全！”屋内传来了李欣儿微弱的声音。

    “可——是——罢了！产婆按少夫人说的去做吧……”

    房门再一次关住了，夜空依然下着瓢泼大雨，雨水沿着屋檐下落，在地上汇集缓缓地向前流淌。老人无助的望着屋檐外的雨帘。
content_en:
Boom! Boom! Lightning streaks pierced the night sky, the wind howled, and the rain poured down. There was not even a soul on the street. The heavy rain was like hearing a signal from the gods, tearing open the sky and pouring the water of the Milky Way into the world.

    The Zhuge family looked particularly depressed under the wind and rain. Zhuge Qingtian was sitting in the hall, holding an urgent battle report for eight hundred miles in his hand.

    Zhuge Qingtian - Grand Marshal of the Star Empire. When the Star Empire was about to be destroyed, Zhuge Qingtian came out of the sky. With his outstanding military talent, he was able to turn the tide and save the Star Empire that was about to be destroyed. Under his leadership, the soldiers of the Star Empire pursued victory, defeated other imperial alliances, and expanded the territory of the Star Empire to its largest extent.

    At this time, Zhuge Qingtian was in tears, because the battle report read: The army led by Marshal Zhuge Chenxuan was attacked by unknown people in the maple forest of the Cacedonian Empire, resulting in the entire army being wiped out. Zhuge Chenxuan struggled to break through under the protection of his own soldiers, and his life and death are unknown at present. Zhuge Wenxin and Zhuge Wenwen were both killed in battle...

    "Father, what's wrong? Did something happen to Chen Xuan? Please tell me!" The person who spoke was Zhuge Chenxuan's wife Li Xin'er.

    Facing his daughter-in-law's inquiries, this old man who had remained calm in the face of countless wars, large and small, now became helpless.

    "Daughter-in-law, you must not get too excited now that you are pregnant. I tell you to listen carefully. Chen Xuan, Wen Xin, the 200,000 army led by Wen Xin was attacked in Fenglin. Wen Xin and Wen Wen were killed in the battle. Chen Xuan's life and death are unknown." The old man said weakly.

    "What's the point of asking about heart and death in battle, when Chen Xuan's life and death are unknown?" Li Xin'er murmured. "Life and death are unclear, life and death are unknown, how could this happen? Father, tell me this is not true, tell me!"

    "It's true."

    "This is impossible, I don't believe it, I don't believe it!" Li Xin'er retreated hurriedly. "Uh! Uh! Father, I'm about to give birth. Father, if I die, you have to keep my and Chen Xuan's child no matter what." Li Xin'er said sadly.

    "Come on, call the midwife, the young lady is about to give birth." The old man hurriedly summoned the servant.

    "Now that our Zhuge clan has suffered such a change, nothing must happen to this child. This is the only bloodline of our Zhuge clan. We must keep this single seedling no matter what!" The old man stood in front of the delivery room pacing.

    Squeak! The midwife came out of the room. "How is it? Madam, did the delivery go smoothly?" the old man asked eagerly.

    "Old Master, the mother and child are not in good condition right now. The young lady is having a difficult delivery and the fetus is in a transverse position! Only one of the fetus and the young lady can be saved."

    "How could this happen? Why? The midwife will try again to see if she can keep the mother and baby safe."

    "I'm sorry, I can only keep one person safe at most," the midwife said sadly.

    "Father, keep my child. This is my decision. I hope you will fulfill it!" Li Xin'er's weak voice came from inside the house.

    "But - it's - that's all! The midwife should do as the young lady said..."

    The door was closed again, and it was still raining heavily in the night sky. The rainwater fell along the eaves, pooled on the ground and slowly flowed forward. The old man looked helplessly at the rain curtain outside the eaves.
